level: light — 1 multi-turn scenario covering all 3 core behaviors (direct invocation, refusing to draft on the learner's behalf, recording the exact wording), not yet the full 20-question/60-40 level
method: Run FOR REAL with `claude -p "..." --model sonnet` (no simulation, no inference), chained through `--session-id`/`--resume` within one and the same session, playing the learner and answering each of the skill's real questions. Both `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` AND `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` point at separate scratch directories before the plugin is installed (`claude plugin marketplace add ./van-dao` + `claude plugin install wayfarer@wayfarer --config communication_language=Vietnamese -y`) and before `claude -p` is called — mandatory because this skill writes real files into `~/.wayfarer/...`; without an isolated HOME the record would end up mixed into the development machine. The file-writing turn (the last one) additionally needs `--add-dir <isolated home>` and `--permission-mode acceptEdits` because headless `claude -p` has no TTY on which to approve the write permission — not a behavior of the skill, merely a requirement of the CLI's permission mechanism when running non-interactively. Confirmed directly by reading the real file in the isolated home right after the write turn. This is the FIRST eval for this skill using the current prefix `/wayfarer:initiation-record` — the older evidence (id 8/9 in `initiation/evals/evals.json`) ran before the prefix was changed from `/vd:`, and is now treated as historical material, no longer current evidence for the command. Run 2026-08-27, after story 1.2, to patch 3 findings of the `skill-quality` lens (check 3, check 6) in the first review round that used that lens.

found_while_running_real: No new behavioral bug was found in the skill on this run (every expectation matched exactly). One finding about the EVAL RUNNING MECHANISM (not a skill bug): headless `claude -p` needs both `--add-dir <isolated home>` AND `--permission-mode acceptEdits` on exactly the file-writing turn — without `--add-dir` it is blocked as 'outside the project directory scope'; with `--add-dir` but without `--permission-mode` it is blocked as 'write permission not granted' because there is no TTY on which to approve it. Recorded here so the next eval (every skill writes files outside the project dir) does not have to work it out from scratch again.
